I wanted a way to see what friends were playing, a chat feature, and a way to listen together.

It turns out the actual product direction ended up aligning pretty well with that vision. The Social Tab I designed is similar to the new Listening Activity rollout. My "Rooms" concept mirrors the Request to Jam feature, and the chat interface is strikingly similar to the Messages feature they added last August.
